answers: Nuclear area: CNV-quiet newly caught patients had a smaller mean epithelial nuclear area than matched non-progressors (28.3 vs 31.2 µm², Δ −2.9 [−4.6, −1.2], AUC 0.21, p 0.016), not significant after Holm (p 0.078); the SD did not differ (Δ −1.3 µm², Holm p 0.88). If anything the nuclei are smaller, not the enlarged nuclei that track aneuploidy (Abel 2024).
Circularity: no difference (0.843 vs 0.843, Holm p 1.00).
Basal-layer crowding: no difference (6.63 vs 6.72 epithelial nuclei within 20 µm, Holm p 1.00).
Peri-epithelial inflammatory density: no difference and no direction (29.4 vs 27.9 per 100 epithelial nuclei, Δ +1.5 [−11.7, +17.4], Holm p 1.00).

Caught by both (offset tiles only): close to the matched non-progressors on every feature (nuclear area 30.7 vs 31.0 µm², Δ −0.4 [−1.8, +1.1]) and above (a) in nuclear area (Δ +2.4 [+0.7, +4.2]); the small-nucleus tendency appears only in the CNV-quiet newly caught samples.
No: PanNuke's inflammatory class pools lymphocytes, plasma cells, neutrophils and macrophages, so plasma-cell density was not measured.
deviations: Tile positions: the pre-specification read tiles at (x, y) × downsample, treating `coords_level` as top-left corners; they are tile centres. The first run therefore measured tiles offset by half a tile. Primary results come from a corrected run of (a) and (c) (cq6–cq8, commit 8465796); the offset run is kept as a record (`stats_offset.json`, `segmentation_qc_offset.json`) and is the only source for (b). Offset and corrected (a) vs (c) results agree (nuclear area Δ −2.8 vs −2.9 µm², Holm p 0.10 vs 0.078; all other features null in both).
(b) not re-measured on corrected tiles: doing so (about 5 GPU-hours) would exceed the 15 GPU-hour cap.

Coordinate check applied to tissue tiles only (grey SD ≥ 10 on the saved tile), changed in commit de6f70b before any feature was computed. Every tile with r < 0.95 was blank glass (grey SD about 2), where the correlation is noise. Under the pre-specified all-tile rule, 25 of 146 offset slides and 3 of 52 corrected slides would have been excluded; on tissue tiles the minimum r was 0.967 (offset) and 0.964 (corrected), and no slide was excluded.

Operational, no effect on outputs (each step writes per-slide outputs and skips finished slides): in the first run, 4 extraction tasks hit the 1-hour limit and were finished as cq3b, and 13 slides orphaned by an h200 preemption and requeue were re-run on cuda as cq4d.
Figure: the overlay is a quarter of a tile region from a smoke-test slide outside all groups, enlarged for legibility; (b) is not plotted because it exists only on offset tiles.
caveats: (a) has 8 patients, so power is low; the nulls do not exclude moderate differences, and the nuclear-area result is unadjusted-only.
Grade was matched at class level (NDBE vs ID/LGD) as pre-specified; within the dysplastic class (a) is mostly LGD (5 LGD, 1 ID) and its matches mostly ID (14 ID, 4 LGD).

F4 and F5 are proxies: there is no Barrett's layer segmenter, PanNuke's inflammatory class is not lymphocyte-specific, and in the smoke overlays some lymphocyte-like stromal cells were called connective.
Only the 256 stored tiles per slide (about 10 mm²) were measured, i.e. what the image model saw, not all tissue; no stain normalisation (scanner matched exactly).
PanNuke's neoplastic/non-neoplastic split is uninformative here (52–53% of epithelial nuclei called neoplastic in every group, both runs).
Matched case–control cohort; results are descriptive and do not feed any predictor.
preamble: **Two runs.** The first run (results commit 889f080, rendered in 15ac82b) read the npz `coords_level` as tile top-left corners. They are tile centres (`barretts_training/scripts/extract_foundation_from_masks.py`, `extract_tiles`: top-left = centre − 112 px, clamped), so every tile was shifted half a tile (about 99 µm) right and down and overlapped the tile the image model saw by a quarter. (a) and (c) were re-extracted and re-segmented with the centre rule; those results are primary. (b) was not re-run, because re-segmenting its 94 slides would take the total over the 15 GPU-hour cap, so (b) is reported from the offset run only, against (a) and (c) from the same run.
